about: Himalayan Solar designs, manufactures, supplies, installs and commissions solar products, mainly solar water pumping systems, plus solar PV modules, inverter charge systems and rooftop power systems. It is based in Panchkula, Haryana, with a manufacturing unit in Karnal (60 MW Mono PERC module capacity). It has executed over 85,000 HP of solar pumping systems for government projects.
sector: Solar energy equipment and solar water pumping systems

objects.purpose: Funding capital expenditure for expansion and upgradation of existing manufacturing facility (60 MW to 160 MW)

promoters.background: Promoters have no prior experience running a listed company. Karthyayini M holds 50.22% pre-issue and sells 7,14,000 shares in the OFS. Manjeet Singh holds 22.00% and is the key person driving the business.

concentration.note: Top 1 customer was 50.00% of FY26 revenue (85.15% FY25, 88.48% FY24); top 5 customers were 99.54% of FY26 revenue. Business is mainly government-linked solar pump projects.

litigation_note: Promoters: 1 criminal case (Rs 9.02 lakh) and against promoters 1 criminal, 1 tax and 1 other matter totalling about Rs 59.99 lakh; 1 tax matter of Rs 1.30 lakh against KMP/SMP. Contingent liabilities of Rs 29.18 crore (mostly bank guarantees) at Mar-26.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 138.32 crore (FY24) to Rs 170.34 crore (FY26) while PAT rose from Rs 4.95 crore to Rs 20.67 crore.
Reported RoNW of 44.04% and ROCE of 35.84% in FY26 are high for the sector.
EBITDA margin improved from 5.66% in FY24 to 17.05% in FY26.
Pending order book of Rs 140.22 crore as of July 31, 2026, about 82% of FY26 revenue.
Empanelled solar partner with several state government departments, with over 85,000 HP of solar pumps executed.
Debt-to-equity improved from 2.28 in FY24 to 0.77 in FY26 as net worth grew.
Plans to raise module capacity from 60 MW to 160 MW with TOPCon bifacial technology using IPO funds.
Revenue base broadened beyond Haryana: Haryana share fell from 88.93% to 52.81% of domestic sales.

risks.title: Extreme customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 1 customer was 50.00% and top 5 customers 99.54% of FY26 revenue (top 1 was 88.48% in FY24). Losing one buyer would hurt revenue badly.

risks.title: Heavy working capital and receivables
risks.detail: Trade receivables jumped to Rs 125.34 crore at Mar-26 from Rs 66.32 crore, about 74% of FY26 revenue. Short-term borrowings are Rs 27.01 crore.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 2.07 crore in FY26 and negative Rs 5.52 crore in FY24 despite reported profits; FY25 was positive Rs 3.90 crore.

risks.title: Dependence on government schemes and policy
risks.detail: Business relies on subsidised solar pump schemes and government projects. Policy or MNRE standard changes, or the government assembling pumps itself, could hurt demand.

risks.title: Debt and lender charge over assets
risks.detail: Secured debt of Rs 51.11 crore at Mar-26 with charge on movable and immovable assets; Rs 3.05 crore unsecured director loan is repayable on demand. Borrowings were Rs 36.12 crore per KPI table.

risks.title: Legal proceedings and compliance lapses
risks.detail: Criminal, tax and other cases against promoters (about Rs 59.99 lakh involved), plus Section 42 share application account non-compliance and delayed RoC, GST, EPF and ESIC filings.

risks.title: Geographic and supplier concentration
risks.detail: Haryana was 52.81% of FY26 domestic revenue (88.93% in FY24); top suppliers contribute most supplies with no long-term contracts. Restated financials were signed by a peer-review CA who is not the statutory auditor.

risks.title: Expansion execution and promoter control
risks.detail: No machinery orders yet placed for the Rs 12.98 crore capex; promoters will hold 70.13% post-issue and have no listed-company experience. Part of the issue is an OFS of 7,14,000 shares.

notes: Restated standalone financials in Rs lakh converted to Rs crore; FY24-FY26 only (no stub period). Borrowings = long-term plus short-term (matches KPI table 3,612.38 lakh for FY26). Cash and bank includes other bank balances. EBITDA, margins, ROCE, RoNW, debt/equity as reported by the RHP (EBITDA excludes other income). EPS shown is adjusted for 3.5:1 bonus; unadjusted basic EPS was 13.72, 45.59, 12.74. Price band, issue price, issue size in rupees and P/E are blank in the RHP. Objects table: general corporate expenses amount is blank. Order book is Rs 14,021.69 lakh at July 31, 2026. Peer EPS is basic only.
